FAQ.title: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.subtitle: Find answers to the most common questions about our Path of Exile currency trading services.
FAQ.contactDescription: Can't find the answer you're looking for? Our support team is here to help you 24/7.
FAQ.answer1: Path of Exile is a free-to-play action RPG developed by Grinding Gear Games, famous for its complex in-game economy—which is where we come in to help!
FAQ.question2: What kind of Path of Exile currency, services, and items do you sell?
FAQ.answer2:
We offer a comprehensive range of products for Path of Exile! Our catalog includes:

- PoE currency: A huge stock of Divine Orbs, Chaos Orbs, Exalted Orbs, Mirrors of Kalandra, and more.
- Unique Items: Find the powerful gear you need to complete your build.
- Services: We offer power leveling and expert build creation to get you ready for the endgame.

Explore our site to see everything we have in stock for the current league!
FAQ.question3: Which Path of Exile league do you sell items for?
FAQ.answer3: Absolutely! We support both the permanent Standard league and the current seasonal Challenge League. Please double-check that you've selected the correct league before completing your purchase to ensure your items arrive in the right place.
FAQ.question4: Are the items and currency for POE1 and POE2? And for which platforms?
FAQ.answer4: Yes, all our products and services are for Path of Exile 1 and Path of Exile 2 on the PC platform. We currently do not support console versions (PlayStation/Xbox).
FAQ.question5: How do I contact you if I have questions or issues?
FAQ.answer5: Our customer support team is ready to help! The fastest way to reach us is through our 24/7 Live Chat on the website. You can also email us at support@pathoftrade.net or use our contact form. We strive to answer all inquiries promptly.
FAQ.deliveryAnswer1: Most orders are delivered within 30 minutes during business hours. During peak times or high demand periods, delivery may take up to 2 hours. We always strive to deliver as quickly as possible while maintaining security.
FAQ.delivery2: How does the in-game delivery work?
FAQ.deliveryAnswer2: After payment confirmation, our trader will contact you in-game using the character name and league you provided. You'll meet at a designated location (usually in town) and complete the trade. Make sure your character is online and available in the specified league.
FAQ.delivery3: What if I'm not online when you try to deliver?
FAQ.deliveryAnswer3: If you're not online, our trader will wait for a reasonable time and then contact you via Discord or email to reschedule. We'll work with you to find a convenient time for delivery. No additional charges apply for rescheduling.
FAQ.delivery4: Can I change my character name or league after placing an order?
FAQ.deliveryAnswer4: Yes, but you must contact our support team immediately. Changes are only possible before delivery begins. Please provide your order number and the new character name/league information.
FAQ.payment1: What payment methods do you accept?
FAQ.paymentAnswer1: We accept major credit cards (Visa, MasterCard, American Express), PayPal, and various cryptocurrencies including Bitcoin, Ethereum, and other popular digital currencies. All payments are processed securely through trusted third-party providers.
FAQ.paymentAnswer2: Absolutely! We use industry-standard encryption and never store your payment information. All transactions are processed through secure, PCI-compliant payment gateways. Your financial data is protected at all times.
FAQ.paymentAnswer3: We offer refunds in specific circumstances: if we cannot complete your order due to stock issues, if there's a significant delay in delivery, or if you receive incorrect items. Refunds are not available for completed deliveries of correct items.
FAQ.paymentAnswer4: No hidden fees! The price you see is the price you pay. All taxes and processing fees are included in the displayed price. There are no additional charges for delivery or service fees.
FAQ.safety1: Is it safe to buy from you?
FAQ.safetyAnswer1: Yes! We've been in business for years with thousands of satisfied customers. We use secure trading methods and have strict policies to protect both buyers and sellers. Your account safety is our top priority.
FAQ.safety2: How do you ensure safe trading to avoid account issues?
FAQ.safetyAnswer2: We use the most advanced and safest trading methods available in Path of Exile. Our experienced traders follow strict protocols to ensure all transactions appear as legitimate player-to-player trades. We never use automated tools or suspicious methods that could trigger detection systems. Our years of experience and thousands of successful trades demonstrate our commitment to safe, secure trading practices.
FAQ.safety3: How do you ensure account security?
FAQ.safetyAnswer3: We never ask for your account password or login credentials. All trades are conducted in-game through the official trading system. We only need your character name and league information for delivery purposes.
FAQ.safety4: What if something goes wrong with my order?
FAQ.safetyAnswer4: Our support team is available 24/7 to resolve any issues. We have a comprehensive tracking system and will work with you to ensure your order is completed successfully. Contact us immediately if you encounter any problems.
FAQ.game1: Do you support all Path of Exile leagues?
FAQ.gameAnswer1: We support both Standard and Challenge leagues for Path of Exile 1 and Path of Exile 2. We update our inventory regularly to match the current league and meta. Check our product pages for league-specific availability.
FAQ.game2: What's the difference between Softcore and Hardcore?
FAQ.gameAnswer2: Softcore leagues allow you to keep your items when you die, while Hardcore leagues are permanent death. We offer currency and items for both types, but make sure to select the correct difficulty when placing your order.
FAQ.game3: Do you have items for new leagues immediately?
FAQ.gameAnswer3: We typically have currency and basic items available within hours of a new league launch. Unique items and specialized gear may take longer to stock. Follow our Discord for real-time updates on new league availability.
FAQ.game4: Can I buy items for multiple characters?
FAQ.gameAnswer4: Yes! You can place separate orders for different characters or leagues. Each order will be delivered to the specified character. We also offer bulk discounts for large orders - contact us for custom pricing.
FAQ.supportAnswer1: Our support team is available 24/7 through Discord and email. Discord typically provides faster responses (within minutes), while email responses usually come within 2-4 hours. We're here to help whenever you need us!
FAQ.support2: How can I track my order status?
FAQ.supportAnswer2: You can track your order through your account dashboard or by contacting our support team with your order number. We'll provide real-time updates on your order status and estimated delivery time.
FAQ.support3: What if I have a complaint or suggestion?
FAQ.supportAnswer3: We value your feedback! You can reach out to us through Discord, email, or our support ticket system. We take all feedback seriously and use it to improve our services. Your satisfaction is our priority.
FAQ.support4: Do you offer customer loyalty programs?
FAQ.supportAnswer4: Yes! We offer discounts for returning customers and bulk purchases. Join our Discord server to stay updated on special promotions, loyalty rewards, and exclusive deals for our community members.

bloodlineAscendancies.title: Bloodline Ascendancy Classes
bloodlineAscendancies.subtitle: Absorb powers from specific bosses and add them to your character as an extra layer of customization
bloodlineAscendancies.description: Bloodline Ascendancy Classes allow you to absorb powers from specific endgame bosses and add them to your character as an extra layer of customization beyond your normal ascendancy. They require Ascendancy points for allocation, can be combined with any ascendancy class, and enable unique passive combinations for new build fantasies.

howItWorks.title: How They Work
howItWorks.description: By defeating certain bosses, you unlock the corresponding Bloodline and can allocate its passives using Ascendancy points, mixing these notables with your main ascendancy. This creates countless synergy possibilities, allowing you to adapt your character to your playstyle and the content you want to farm.

bloodlines.name: Farrul Bloodline
bloodlines.description: Derived from the Beast ecosystem, adding a predator fantasy and interaction with summons and beasts.
bloodlines.detailedDescription: The Farrul Bloodline channels the power of ancestral predators, allowing you to summon and control powerful beasts. This ascendancy is ideal for builds focused on minions and summons, offering unique synergies with the Beast system and wild creatures.

bloodlines.name: Lycia Bloodline
bloodlines.description: Herald/Sanctum themed, enabling specific archetypes like low life variations in certain configurations.
bloodlines.detailedDescription: The Lycia Bloodline incorporates heraldic powers and Sanctum mechanics, offering unique tools for low life and energy shield builds. Perfect for players seeking defensive builds with high offensive potential.

bloodlines.name: Delirious Bloodline
bloodlines.description: Focused on Delirium themes, opening scaling niches and unique risk/reward for aggressive builds.
bloodlines.detailedDescription: The Delirious Bloodline embraces the chaos and madness of Delirium, offering extreme scalability with significant risks. Ideal for aggressive builds seeking to maximize damage through high-risk, high-reward mechanics.

bloodlines.name: Catarina Bloodline
bloodlines.description: Derived from Betrayal, with hooks for minion archetypes and alternative offensive/defensive scaling interactions.
bloodlines.detailedDescription: The Catarina Bloodline incorporates dark powers and betrayal mechanics, offering unique tools for minion builds and alternative scaling. Perfect for builds seeking complex synergies and unique mechanics.

bloodlines.name: Aul Bloodline
bloodlines.description: Associated with Delve, bringing situational tools for deep and technological setups.
bloodlines.detailedDescription: The Aul Bloodline channels technological and mineral powers from Delve, offering unique tools for builds that explore the depths. Ideal for specialized setups and builds seeking unique progression mechanics.

bloodlines.name: Olroth Bloodline
bloodlines.description: Linked to Expedition, offering utility and offensive paths for farming and progression.
bloodlines.detailedDescription: The Olroth Bloodline incorporates explosive powers and Expedition mechanics, offering unique tools for farming and progression. Perfect for builds seeking farm efficiency and explosion mechanics.

whyItMatters.title: Why This Matters
whyItMatters.description: These Bloodlines expand the creative ceiling of builds, allowing you to mix boss passives with your ascendancy tree and address specific gaps in damage, defense, or utility. Since they require Ascendancy points, there are real opportunity cost decisions, but the reward is enabling high-impact combinations that didn't exist before.

bestPractices.title: Build Best Practices
tips: Plan ahead for free Ascendancy points to fit a Bloodline without breaking your build's core
Map synergies between your desired Bloodline and your key clusters/items, prioritizing bosses whose Bloodline complements your scaling
Consider progression: unlocking your target Bloodline early accelerates testing and validation of your final setup

questions.question: What are Bloodline Ascendancies?
questions.answer: They are additional classes obtained by defeating specific bosses, which grant allocatable passives using Ascendancy points.

questions.question: Can I use them with any ascendancy?
questions.answer: Yes, they can be paired with any Ascendancy Class and mixed with your passives.

questions.question: Do I need new points?
questions.answer: They consume existing Ascendancy points, requiring planning in your ascendancy tree route.
